prompt:
Build a real-time full-stack chat application using Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

The application should allow multiple users to join a common chat room and exchange messages instantly in real time.

Frontend Requirements:

Use ONLY:
index.html
style.css
app.js
Create a modern responsive chat UI.
Include:
username input section
join chat button
chat message area
online status/header
message input field
send button
Messages should appear instantly without page refresh.
Differentiate own messages and other users' messages visually.
Auto-scroll to latest message.
Show timestamps beside messages.
Show join/leave system notifications.

Backend Requirements:

Use Node.js + Express + Socket.IO only.
Backend should:
create server
handle socket connections
broadcast messages
track connected users
emit join/leave events
support multiple clients simultaneously
Use port 3000.

Functional Requirements:

When user enters username and joins:
establish socket connection
notify all users
When message is sent:
emit to server
broadcast to all connected users
Prevent empty messages.
Handle disconnect events properly.

Architecture Rules:

Frontend and backend must be separated cleanly.
Keep logic modular.
Do not generate unnecessary files.
No React.
No Vite.
No database.
No authentication system.
No external UI libraries.

Expected Folder Structure:
project/
├── backend/
│ ├── server.js
│ └── package.json
├── frontend/
│ ├── index.html
│ ├── style.css
│ └── app.js

Extra Requirements:

Automatically serve frontend using Express static middleware.
Frontend should open directly on:
http://localhost:3000
Add proper console logs throughout backend for debugging:
user connected
user disconnected
message received
server started
Code must be fully working without placeholders or TODO comments.
Generate clean readable production-style code.

tasks.task: Create backend/package.json — Defines backend dependencies: express, socket.io.
Create backend/utils/users.js — Utility for managing active chat users (add, remove, get).
tasks.purpose: Utility for managing active chat users (add, remove, get).

tasks.task: Create backend/services/socketService.js — Encapsulates Socket.IO event listeners and broadcasting logic. [imports: backend/utils/users.js]
tasks.purpose: Encapsulates Socket.IO event listeners and broadcasting logic.

tasks.task: Create backend/server.js — Configures Express, initializes HTTP server, integrates Socket.IO, serves frontend, starts listening. [imports: backend/package.json, backend/services/socketService.js]
tasks.purpose: Configures Express, initializes HTTP server, integrates Socket.IO, serves frontend, starts listening.

tasks.task: Create server.js — Express app — cors, json, static serving, route mounting, error handler, port 3000
tasks.purpose: Express app — cors, json, static serving, route mounting, error handler, port 3000

tasks.task: Create frontend/index.html — Defines the chat application's user interface structure.
tasks.purpose: Defines the chat application's user interface structure.

tasks.purpose: Styles the chat application for a modern and responsive look.
